recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **Ground meat:** 1 kg ground beef (or a beef and pork mixture) ([**1:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=109s))
- **Onions & Garlic:** 1 large onion (and garlic to taste) ([**0:25**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=25s))
- **Olive oil:** 15 mL (if caramelizing onions)
- **Panko breadcrumbs:** 55–60 g ([**1:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=115s))
- **Heavy cream:** 80 mL–100 g ([**2:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=132s))
- **Eggs:** 2 large eggs ([**2:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=132s))
- **Goat cheese:** 150 g ([**3:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=230s))
- **Ketchup:** 29.5 mL ([**3:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=197s))
- **Worcestershire sauce:** 15–29.5 mL ([**3:00**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=180s))
- **Spices:** 5–7.5 mL sea salt, 5 mL ground ginger, 5 mL steak seasoning, 5 mL "Slap Ya Mama" Cajun seasoning, 5 mL Tony Chachere's seasoning, and 15 mL black pepper (or white pepper) ([**2:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=150s))
recipe-section-1.html:
• Ground meat: 1 kg ground beef (or a beef and pork mixture) (1:49)
  • Onions & Garlic: 1 large onion (and garlic to taste) (0:25)
  • Olive oil: 15 mL (if caramelizing onions)
  • Panko breadcrumbs: 55–60 g (1:55)
  • Heavy cream: 80 mL–100 g (2:12)
  • Eggs: 2 large eggs (2:12)
  • Goat cheese: 150 g (3:50)
  • Ketchup: 29.5 mL (3:17)
  • Worcestershire sauce: 15–29.5 mL (3:00)
  • Spices: 5–7.5 mL sea salt, 5 mL ground ginger, 5 mL steak seasoning, 5 mL "Slap Ya Mama" Cajun seasoning, 5 mL Tony Chachere's seasoning, and 15 mL black pepper (or white pepper) (2:30)
recipe-section-1.title: For the Meatloaf Mix

recipe-section-2.markdown:
- **Ketchup:** 44.5 mL ([**7:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=428s))
- **Mustard:** 29.5 mL (German sausage stand mustard, Dijon, or honey mustard) ([**6:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=366s))
- **Brown sugar:** 27 g ([**7:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=428s))
- **Worcestershire sauce:** 5 mL ([**7:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=428s))
recipe-section-2.html:
• Ketchup: 44.5 mL (7:08)
  • Mustard: 29.5 mL (German sausage stand mustard, Dijon, or honey mustard) (6:06)
  • Brown sugar: 27 g (7:08)
  • Worcestershire sauce: 5 mL (7:08)
recipe-section-2.title: For the Ketchup Glaze

recipe-section-4.markdown:
- Preheat your oven to 175 °C ([**0:39**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=39s)).
- **Option A (S sweeter taste):** Caramelize your finely chopped onions and garlic in a pan with olive oil before starting ([**0:25**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=25s)).
- **Option B (Quicker/Spicier bite):** Skip the stovetop cooking completely ([**1:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=65s)). Pulse raw onions in a food processor until they are super duper fine so they melt into the meat ([**1:41**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=101s)).
recipe-section-4.html:
• Preheat your oven to 175 °C (0:39).
  • Option A (S sweeter taste): Caramelize your finely chopped onions and garlic in a pan with olive oil before starting (0:25).
  • Option B (Quicker/Spicier bite): Skip the stovetop cooking completely (1:05). Pulse raw onions in a food processor until they are super duper fine so they melt into the meat (1:41).
recipe-section-4.title: Step 1: Oven Setup & Onion Prep

recipe-section-5.markdown:
- Place 1 kg of ground meat into a large mixing bowl ([**1:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=109s)).
- Add the caramelized or finely processed onions and garlic to the meat ([**0:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=48s)).
- Pour in 55–60 g of panko breadcrumbs, 80 mL–100 g of heavy cream, and crack in 2 large eggs ([**1:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=115s)).
recipe-section-5.html:
• Place 1 kg of ground meat into a large mixing bowl (1:49).
  • Add the caramelized or finely processed onions and garlic to the meat (0:48).
  • Pour in 55–60 g of panko breadcrumbs, 80 mL–100 g of heavy cream, and crack in 2 large eggs (1:55).
recipe-section-5.title: Step 2: Combine the Base Matrix

recipe-section-6.markdown:
- Add 29.5 mL of ketchup and 29.5 mL of Worcestershire sauce ([**3:00**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=180s)).
- Season with 5 mL each of salt, ginger powder, steak seasoning, Cajun seasoning, creole seasoning, and 15 mL of pepper ([**2:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=150s)).
- Crumble 150 g of goat cheese into the bowl ([**3:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=230s)).
- Mix everything thoroughly by hand to guarantee the pockets of goat cheese evenly disperse without entirely dissolving into the meat ([**3:36**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=216s)).
recipe-section-6.html:
• Add 29.5 mL of ketchup and 29.5 mL of Worcestershire sauce (3:00).
  • Season with 5 mL each of salt, ginger powder, steak seasoning, Cajun seasoning, creole seasoning, and 15 mL of pepper (2:30).
  • Crumble 150 g of goat cheese into the bowl (3:50).
  • Mix everything thoroughly by hand to guarantee the pockets of goat cheese evenly disperse without entirely dissolving into the meat (3:36).
recipe-section-6.title: Step 3: Season and Fold

recipe-section-7.markdown:
- Ditch the traditional loaf pan. Shape the mixture into one single, massive uniform loaf directly onto a baking sheet pan ([**5:07**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=307s)).
- In a separate small bowl, whisk together 44.5 mL of ketchup, 29.5 mL of your chosen mustard, 27 g of brown sugar, and 5 mL of Worcestershire sauce ([**7:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=428s)).
- Use a pastry brush to coat the top and sides of the shaped meatloaf evenly with the glaze ([**6:32**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=392s)).
recipe-section-7.html:
• Ditch the traditional loaf pan. Shape the mixture into one single, massive uniform loaf directly onto a baking sheet pan (5:07).
  • In a separate small bowl, whisk together 44.5 mL of ketchup, 29.5 mL of your chosen mustard, 27 g of brown sugar, and 5 mL of Worcestershire sauce (7:08).
  • Use a pastry brush to coat the top and sides of the shaped meatloaf evenly with the glaze (6:32).
recipe-section-7.title: Step 4: Shape and Prepare Glaze

recipe-section-8.markdown:
- Bake at 175 °C for exactly 50 minutes until juicy and tender ([**5:00**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=300s)).
- Slice with a spatula and serve immediately while hot ([**7:54**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JAiOKifyYEM&t=474s)).
recipe-section-8.html:
• Bake at 175 °C for exactly 50 minutes until juicy and tender (5:00).
  • Slice with a spatula and serve immediately while hot (7:54).
recipe-section-8.title: Step 5: Bake and Serve
